limitations.quote: I’ll clock the counter, fix the triangle’s endpoint reversals
limitations.note: The patch fixed the combinational counter feedback but also changed the triangle’s first post-reset sample from 31 to 1 and made square mode force zero on entry instead of holding the previous output until the counter reached a transition point.

The testbench expected the rewritten triangle sequence and immediate zero on square-mode entry, so passing confirmed the new behavior rather than verifying that the counter fix preserved the existing behavior.
